name: Yeet a Dude: MiniGames
summary:
Well, back in the day, games were simple — no rules, no hand-holding, just pure experimentation. Yeet a Dude brings that spirit back in a playful, over-the-top physics sandbox, where chaos and curiosity lead the way.
